{{Quote|The Sith Empire must rise again&hellip;but the old Jedi Masters stand in our way.|Zona Luka|<ref name="TSW4" />}}
An '''uprising''' formed the opening gambit in [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun's]] plan to restore a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Golden Age of the Sith|Golden Age]] to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The targets of Kun's intrigue were the one-time [[Jedi Master/Legends|Masters]] of several [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]], all possessed with [[Force ghost/Legends|spirits]] of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. Nine [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolytes]] left the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] with the imminent [[Death/Legends|murders]] of their former teachers nigh at hand. All across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the element of surprise saw Jedi Masters caught unawares as the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] descended upon them; Kun himself [[Duel in the Senate|slew]] his own Master on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] itself, in [[Senate Hall]] of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Despite the demoralizing effect it had on the [[Sentience/Legends|citizens]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], the death toll of Exar Kun's Sith uprising was minimal, and the Order was spurred into redoubling their efforts to end the Dark Lord's [[Great Sith War/Legends|Sith War]] once and for all.
